page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs provided by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This server does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. To support high-throughput data transfers and distributed architectures, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 160 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or integrated GPU hardware.

Given its high core density and compute-heavy 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c7nex.32xlarge offers a resource profile optimized for compute-intensive tasks rather than memory-heavy databases. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention. It is suited for workloads such as high-performance computing, large-scale web serving, batch processing, and distributed analytics that benefit from high parallel processing capacity and substantial network throughput.
